- `ignore_concentration`: 2026-01-18, leaves the control exception unresolved, $488 impact.
- `cancel_all_open_pos`: final close outcome 2026-01-19, $13,951 impact, disrupts open commitments, and requires separate approval/policy exception.

The $488.28 residual risk was escalated to the controller/approver, and the Oracle, Slack, and control-audit records were updated.
